title.narrative: IOM. Enhancing protection of migrants in West and Central Africa (WCA) through consolidated migration governance in Mali and Niger. 2021-2022.

description.narrative:
The proposed project aims to contribute to enhancing the protection of migrants in West and Central Africa (WCA) through consolidated migration governance in Mali and Niger. Specifically, this project will contribute to:
1) Strengthening data and evidence base on migration trends through continued flow monitoring of migrants and displaced populations along key migration routes and at displacement sites, collection of data on migrant deaths and disappearances along the main migratory routes, mainstreaming of key protection and counter-trafficking indicators, bolstering harmonization of indicators and inter-governmental collaboration on data collection and analysis, and the building of government capacities to collect, harmonize and process administrative migration data, while promoting and incorporating mainstreaming of gender indicators and gathering gender disaggregated information in data collection activities (outcome 1)
2) Strengthening capacity building on migration management of government actors at regional, national and local levels to mainstream migration into public policy, effectively implementing relevant migration governance frameworks and policies while engaging relevant actors (outcome 2)
